scoring_justification: Cannot recompute the full MD trajectories; verify structural properties (RDF peak presence, monotonic yielding strain trends) from agent-submitted CSV artifacts based on the paper’s reported behaviour.

outputs.description: RDF curves for (8,0) CNT after relaxation at 12% strain. For T=0K the 1.5–1.6 Å region must lack a significant peak; for finite T a distinct peak must appear.
Yielding strain at which sp3 bonds or bond rotations first appear during compression of a (10,0) CNT under various strain rates and temperatures.

output_contract.notes: Scoring evaluates structural trends: for RDF, peak presence in the 1.5–1.6 Å range only at finite temperatures; for yielding strain, monotonic decrease with increasing temperature (fixed strain rate) and with decreasing strain rate (fixed temperature). Exact numeric values are not required; trends must hold per defect type.

steps.target: RDF peak in 1.5–1.6 Å present only at finite temperatures (300, 800, 1600 K) and absent at 0 K
steps.tolerance: Relative intensity thresholds: for 0 K normalized intensity ≤ 0.15; for finite T ≥ 0.25
steps.description: Checks that the RDF of the (8,0) CNT at 12 % strain shows a clear peak around 1.5–1.6 Å only at temperatures 300, 800 and 1600 K, while the 0 K curve lacks such a peak.

steps.target: Yielding strain decreases monotonically with increasing temperature (fixed strain rate) and decreases with decreasing strain rate (fixed temperature) for each defect type (sp3 and rotation)
steps.tolerance: Strict non-increasing order; all required combinations of temperature, strain rate and defect type must be present.
steps.description: Verifies that for the (10,0) CNT compression simulations the yielding strain for sp3 bond formation and bond rotation follows the reported strain‑rate and temperature dependence.
